title: ZX Bank Asia Mobile App Guide

nodes.title: Overview
nodes.summary: The ZX Bank Asia mobile app supports Android and iOS and offers intuitive banking features, advanced security, and real-time assistance for managing finances on the go.

nodes.title: 1. How to Download the ZX Bank Asia App
nodes.summary: Download the ZX Bank Asia app by searching for it in the Google Play Store (Android) or the Apple App Store (iOS) and tapping Download or Get.

nodes.title: 2. How to Activate Mobile Banking
nodes.summary: Activate mobile banking by registering with your registered mobile number and customer ID/account number, verifying via OTP, setting a login PIN or biometric (fingerprint/Face ID), and completing e-KYC if prompted.

nodes.title: 3. How to Login
nodes.summary: Log in by opening the app and entering your PIN or using biometric login (if enabled) to access your dashboard securely.

nodes.title: 4. App Features
nodes.summary: The app covers account management, fund transfers (NEFT/IMPS/UPI) with payee management, bill payments and QR scanning, card management, loans, rewards, NRI and wealth services, and the Zia chatbot assistant.

children.title: Account Management
children.summary: Check savings/current account balances, view transaction history and mini statements, and track FD, RD, and loan details in real time.

children.title: Fund Transfer
children.summary: Transfer funds within ZX Bank or to other banks via NEFT, IMPS, or UPI by selecting or adding a payee, entering amount and remarks, and confirming with PIN/OTP.

children.title: **Within ZX Bank / Other Banks**
children.summary: To transfer, tap Fund Transfer, choose ZX Bank or Other Bank (NEFT/IMPS/UPI), select or add a payee, enter the amount and remarks, and confirm with PIN/OTP.

children.title: **Add Payee**
children.summary: Add a payee via Fund Transfer → Manage Payees by entering the payee's account info (name, bank details, IFSC) or UPI ID and verifying through OTP.

children.title: Bill Payments & QR
children.summary: Pay electricity, water, gas, mobile, and credit card bills, and scan QR codes at merchants or for quick money transfers.

children.title: Cards
children.summary: View, block, and manage credit/debit cards, apply for new cards, and set transaction limits for ATM, POS, online, and contactless usage.

children.title: **Check, Apply & Manage Credit/Debit Cards**
children.summary: View existing cards with usage summary, due dates, statements, and reward points; block cards instantly, reset card PINs, and apply for new credit or debit cards.

children.title: **Set Card Limits**
children.summary: Set or adjust transaction limits on cards for ATM, POS, online, and contactless usage through Manage Cards.

children.title: Loans
children.summary: View loans, EMIs, schedules, and statements, and apply for new home, personal, or vehicle loans by filling a form, uploading KYC, and tracking status.

children.title: Rewards
children.summary: Check current reward points in the Rewards tab and redeem them instantly for vouchers, cashback, or gift cards.

children.title: NRI & Wealth
children.summary: Access NRI services, mutual funds, wealth advisory, and initiate investments from the app.

children.title: Chatbot – **Zia**
children.summary: Ask Zia, the in-app chatbot, for help with account queries, product info, quick balance, and transaction support.

nodes.title: 5. Security Options
nodes.summary: Security options include biometric login (fingerprint/Face ID), dynamic device registration and OTP validation, and instant blocking of internet/mobile banking through the app.

nodes.title: 6. Other Popular Services
nodes.summary: Other services include requesting a cheque book, updating contact details with OTP, viewing mini statements, locating branches/ATMs, and receiving real-time notifications for transactions and offers.

nodes.title: 7. Customer Support
nodes.summary: Get support through in-app chat or helpline, email, or by scheduling branch appointments via the app.
